title: Controlling Gender Bias in Retrieval via a Backpack Architecture

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifies gender bias in document rankings using Rank Bias (RaB) and Average Rank Bias (ARaB) metrics. The evaluation calculates the gender magnitude of retrieved documents based on the occurrence of female-associated terms (she, woman, her) versus male-associated terms (he, man, him) on a set of queries filtered to exclude explicit gender terms.
